subject: science
concept: Understanding that removing one part of an ecosystem affects the others
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Ecosystems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student removes one organism card from a built food web and traces which other organisms are affected
exercise.pictorial: Student predicts what happens to a food web when a pictured organism disappears
exercise.abstract: Student explains a realistic chain of effects when one species is removed from an ecosystem

misconception_flags: assumes removing one organism has no effect on any other part of the ecosystem

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
